'''Shisha Mor''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who was long [[Death/Legends|dead]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but was said to have used an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Choah Belt/Legends|Choah Belt]] as a hideout.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Fortress of Fortune}}</ref>
